messages:
maya: Heads-up: Greenline Labs says they need tenant-level routing parity before pilot. Their asks are a bit different: per-tenant model allowlist, fallback chain, per-tenant quantization profile selection, and a billing cap enforcement.
diego: quant profile per-tenant is new. Do they need model-level quant choices exposed in the API or just a mapping?
anika: SE note: they want the admin to pick a quant profile per-tenant so that models served to their users are quantized for reduced cost. Also want embedding isolation (separate embeddings index) and a hard monthly billing cap. No DSL, just controls.
maya: timeline = pilot in 4 weeks. Sales says competitor promises parity in 2 weeks.
soren: engineering: we can do a "controls shim" that wires allowlist + fallback + quant map + billing cap. Estimate 3 engineers 3w including perf tests and canary. Full policy engine still 10w and covers more use cases.
ellie: UX: admin page needs quant profile dropdown, billing cap slider, allowlist checkboxes, fallback drag order. Mockups doable in 4 days reusing quota components.
diego: infra note: embedding isolation means separate index provisioning + access control. Ops effort ~1w to automate. Billing cap: tie into quota service to enforce hard throttle when hit.
contracts-bot: Reminder: Written commitments over 30d require GC review.
maya: commercial: offer pilot parity shim with FF and audit logs; commit to scoping policy engine in the next quarter. Keep written milestone limited to "scope and timeline" not a multi-month SLA.
soren: perf acceptance: p50 delta <+20ms, p95 <+70ms, billing enforcement within 2s of threshold. Audit logs must include request_id, tenant_id, decision, quant_profile.
anika: config snippet for shim:
{"tenant":"greenline","allowlist":["rw-large","rw-medium"],"fallback":["rw-medium","rw-small"],"quant_profile":"int8-fast","billing_cap":{"monthly_usd":5000}}
maya: decision: APPROVE parity-shim track with feature-flag, audit logs, embedding isolation automation, and a Q3 commitment to full policy engine scoping. Action items: @soren start spike, @ellie mockups, @diego ops automation for embeddings, @maya draft customer milestone email, @anika prepare pilot checklist.
deploy-bot: Canary plan queued: "greenline-parity/shim-rc1" -> greenline-only pool -> regional -> global.
soren: starting spike today; will post perf numbers by EOD Friday.
